individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot where each marker is one of the n=141 individual sample measurements; marginal histograms summarize the full set of raw values without hiding variability.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present on the scatter points or histograms (the red curves are gamma distribution fits, not error bars).

individual-data-points.explanation: Each point is the mean of 6 replicate samples per reporter (per caption) with s.d. error bars; the underlying individual replicate values are not overlaid.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Data represents the mean ± s.d. of 6 samples per reporter (n = 2 biological replicates á technical triplicates or duplicates [HCC1806 Per2-Luc, n = 5])
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars (horizontal and vertical) are shown on each point and are defined in the caption as mean +/- s.d.

individual-data-points.explanation: Density/line curves showing normal distributions of subtype-averaged parameters; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present; the panel shows smooth fitted density curves only.

individual-data-points.explanation: Box plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points, and here individual sample points (Per2-Luc/Bmal1-Luc dots) are additionally shown on top of each box.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: with the bottom and top edges of the boxes representing the 25th and 75th percentiles, respectively. Extending whiskers represent data points within 1.5 times the interquartile range from lower and upper quartile. Median values are marked by red horizontal lines, and outliers by red crosses.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Box, whisker, median and outlier elements are all explicitly defined in the caption.

individual-data-points.explanation: Polar histograms display the full probability distribution of phase differences per cell line; this is a distributional/histogram-type display, not a mean needing a points overlay.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present on the polar histogram bars.

individual-data-points.explanation: Polar histogram showing the subtype-level probability distribution of phase differences; histogram-type distributional display is exempt from requiring an individual-points overlay.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present on the polar histogram bars.

individual-data-points.explanation: A single illustrative example line/signal trace with model fit; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present; this is a single example trace used for illustration.

individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot where each of the n=117 points is an individual sample's fitted parameters; scatter plots are exempt since the points themselves are the individual data.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Error bars represent the standard deviation of the fitted parameters, reflecting their uncertainty as determined by the fitting process.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars are shown on the scatter points and are defined in the caption as the s.d. of the fitted parameters.
